item.title: 'Whence the Weeping' quest walkthrough in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's how you complete the "Whence the Weeping" side quest in Phantom Blade Zero and where you must go to find the source of the weeping.
item.content:encoded: "Whence the Weeping" is a side quest in Phantom Blade Zero that you start very early in the game. Unlike the "A Healer's Mercy" and "Flesh Lily" secondary missions, which have more straightforward objectives, this quest asks you to simply "find the source of the weeping." Besides, it takes longer to finish than one would assume based on when this side quest starts.

item.title: New James Bond Officially Joins The 007 Franchise Today
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn casting news without substantial prestige project indicators.] Isaac Rouse is the new James Bond in SilverFin, an adaptation of 007 author Charlie Higson's young adult novel based on Ian Fleming's super spy.
item.content:encoded: Ian Fleming's James Bond is set for a cinematic revival with director Denis Villeneuve's in-the-works feature film, currently known colloquially as Bond 26. Casting for the new 007 is currently underway, with a half-dozen leading men in contention to succeed actor Daniel Craig, who retired as Bond in 2021's No Time To Die after starring in five franchise films.

item.title: How to get comms modules in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.dc:creator: Ford James
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] This guide explains how to get comms modules in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4 and the best locations to find them.
item.content:encoded: Getting comms modules in DMZ in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a pain in the butt, because this epic-tier crafting ingredient is incredibly elusive if you don't know where to look. You need comms modules to unlock uncommon ingredient printing (along with high-tenacity fibers), to increase your weapon storage, and for other equipment such as fulton drop markers. Once you've unlocked epic ingredient printing you can simply make more, but that's not feasible until you've acquired even rarer ingredients.

item.title: 'Rings of Power' Season 3 Will Introduce a Character That Subverts Tolkien’s Mythos
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.category: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
item.description: [Filtered: Generic TV series update without substantial film/prestige value.] 'The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power' will introduce an "Orc with an arc."
item.content:encoded: The Age of Men is over. The Age of the Orc Discourse has begun. In a recent interview with IGN about the upcoming season of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, co-showrunner Patrick McKay said big changes are coming, including a five-year time skip. McKay went as far as to describe season 3 as a “soft reboot” of sorts. While that’s certainly a big deal, another line in the interview will stand out for many Tolkien-heads. The show will introduce “an Orc with an arc.”

item.title: James Gunn Finally Confirming What’s Official DCU Canon in The Suicide Squad
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn (DC) with secondary podcast/canon clarification filler.] James Gunn will decide DCU canon in a podcast all about 2021's The Suicide Squad
item.content:encoded: Ever since James Gunn was named co-head of DC Studios in 2022, the filmmaker has spent years answering fan questions about what past and current projects constitute the new DC Universe canon. One of the biggest points of contention is 2021's The Suicide Squad, which Gunn directed before the new DCU was a thing. Now he's finally going to give the definitive answer on exactly what from the film is canon, and you'll be able to watch the whole thing.

item.title: Best Guns in the Modern Warfare 4 Beta
item.dc:creator: Ford James
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Our guide lists the top five guns in the Modern Warfare 4 meta right now.
item.content:encoded: The best guns in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4are exactly what you should be using if you want to be part of the meta right now. This is one of the best Call of Duty multiplayer experiences in a long time, and with a vast array of guns to choose from, you can dominate the skill-based matchmaking and improve your kill-death ratio.

item.title: 20 Years Later, Avatar’s Deepest Episode Has Never Been More Important
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about 20-year-old episode, not new sequel news.] Avatar: The Last Airbender’s “The Guru” explains the chakras — and may hold the key to Pavi’s mysterious vision in Seven Havens episode 9.
item.content:encoded: “The Guru” is the penultimate episode of Avatar: The Last Airbender Book 2, and it introduces Guru Pathik (Brian George) as Aang’s (Zachary Tyler Eisen) spiritual guide. After receiving an invitation via Appa, Aang visits the Eastern Air Temple hoping to learn how he can master the Avatar state. Instead, he gets an elaborate lesson on the nature of spiritual energy and its relationship to the chakras. Nearly two decades after its original release, “The Guru” feels even more relevant than ever before.

item.title: 15 Years Later, the Most Near-Perfect Fast and Furious Movie Is Getting From Netflix
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming-leaving clickbait; nostalgia retrospective framing ("15 years later").] Even after 11 movies, Fast Five is still the best by a mile. Watch it now, while you still can.
item.content:encoded: For a long time, I assumed the Fast & Furious franchise were beneath me. The movies appeared to be nothing more than a series of vapid car commercials and, not being much of a car guy, I wasn't interested. But during the pandemic, I got pressured into watching the first one and really enjoyed it. Before I knew it, I’d watched every installment and couldn’t wait for the next one. That's the power of family.

item.title: 9 Years Ago, Netflix Released a Rare Sci-Fi Sequel Even Better Than the Original
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective; generic TV series renewal/season news.] Season 2 of Stranger Things premiered nine years ago, which proved to be nearly as good as season 1 thanks to some great new characters
item.content:encoded: The “sophomore slump” or the “difficult second album” has generally been an expression that’s applied to music. After a band or a solo artist launches their career with a hit record, it can be challenging to recapture that same energy and excitement. After all, it's one thing to work on your best idea in solitude for years. It's another to suddenly feel immense pressure to follow-up that first hit with something even better. The same can hold true for TV. Many of the greatest television shows fail to deliver on their second outing — like Heroes and True Detective, to name just a couple.

item.title: 'Slow Horses' Season 7 Confirmed? Release Date, Plot, and Everything You Need to Know
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: [Filtered: Generic TV series renewal news; non-horror, non-prestige series.] Here’s when you’ll find out what happens next after that brutal cliffhanger
item.content:encoded: Apple’s tight spy thriller Slow Horsesusually ties up each season-long mystery in six episodes, but the season 6 finale ended with a shocking cliffhanger. If you haven’t read Mick Herron’s Slough House books and are desperate to know what happens next, including which characters will be returning, we’ve got some answers. Here’s everything we know about Slow Horses season 7, including the potential release date and plot details.

item.title: All ribbon locations in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] In this guide, you find all ribbon locations in Phantom Blade Zero, and how to get there, so you can complete the "Young Mistress" side quest.
item.content:encoded: If you find all the ribbons in the Village of Lu you will complete an important Phantom Blade Zero side quest: "Young Mistress." They were left by Mu Xiaokui, daughter of Soul's master. He has known her since she was a child, and they have established a bond that you can only truly understand by hearing the short dialogues that play whenever you collect a ribbon. In addition, completing this side quest also makes the final boss fight in the area more challenging.

item.title: Where to find the Flesh Lily in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] In this guide, we explain where you can find the Flesh Lily in Phantom Blade Zero to complete Yu'er's side quest.
item.content:encoded: Locating the Flesh Lily in Phantom Blade Zero is part of one of the first secondary missions in the game. The "Flesh Lily" is a long quest that you only complete after reaching the fourth area in the game, Pangzhen. Although it takes a while for you to see the conclusion of this tale, completing the first step is worthwhile, as it involves obtaining one of the strongest weapons in the early game.

item.title: Where to find the Outpost cell key in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where to find the cell key in Phantom Blade Zero to open the locked door in the Outpost Courtyard, and the reward from opening it.
item.content:encoded: The Outpost cell key is a secondary objective in Phantom Blade Zero that teaches you that exploring the maps thoroughly is worthwhile. As you progress in the story, you will come across plenty of locked doors, and it might take some time before you can obtain the means to open them, as some are connected to the main story.

item.title: 'A Healer's Mercy' quest walkthrough in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Marloes Valentina Stella
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where to find the wounded thieves' locations needed to complete 'A Healer's Mercy' in Phantom Blade Zero
item.content:encoded: To complete "A Healer's Mercy" in Phantom Blade Zero, you must find four lost thieves in the Crimson Forest, the second region. As none of them are waiting on the main path, it's quite a hassle to distribute Yu'er's medicine and get the thieves back to thieving.

item.title: All medicine locations for 'Apprentice Healer' in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Marloes Valentina Stella
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where to find the medicinal herb locations needed to complete the "Apprentice Healer" quest in Phantom Blade Zero
item.content:encoded: To complete the "Apprentice Healer" quest in Phantom Blade Zero, you must find three medicinal herbs for Yu'er. It's easier said than done, as two of these herbs are found in a hidden valley, and entering this mysterious location is quite the challenge on its own.

item.title: Where to find the primal stone for 'A Severed Mindseal' in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Marloes Valentina Stella
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's the primal stone location needed to complete 'A Severed Mindseal' in Phantom Blade Zero.
item.content:encoded: To find the Primal Stone during the "A Severed Mindseal" quest in Phantom Blade Zero, you must search a mysterious tower imbued with primal energy. It's easier said than done, but you'll make the Friendly Shadow Warden (that odd fellow you met on the roof of the Sha-Chi Tower) very happy.

item.title: Scarlett Johansson’s Most Unsettling Sci-Fi Movie Is Officially Getting Cut From Netflix
item.dc:creator: Ryan Epps
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming departure clickbait; not substantial prestige film coverage.] Scarlett Johansson’s strangest sci-fi movie is a haunting experience worth catching before it leaves Netflix.
item.content:encoded: Scarlett Johansson has spent years playing some of sci-fi’s most recognizable women. Luc Besson transformed her into something approaching a god in 2014’s Lucy, and the much-maligned live-action Ghost in the Shell gave her a fully cybernetically enhanced body to play around with in a near-future Newport City. Of course, there’s also Black Widow, the former assassin who became one of the Marvel Cinematic Universe’s most dependable heroes across nine films, from Iron Man 2 to Black Widow. Johansson has built a career playing characters who straddle the line between human and something otherworldly, but you’ve never seen ScarJo quite like this.

item.title: The best Han 86 build in Modern Warfare 4
item.dc:creator: Ford James
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] A guide detailing the best Han 86 build in Modern Warfare 4, along with the loadout and class to run with it.
item.content:encoded: The best Han 86 build in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is likely to be something most players search for at one point or another, because it's the very first assault rifle you unlock in multiplayer. Not only that, but since the gun can be found on practically every single basic soldier in DMZ, it's incredibly easy to level it up and acquire most of the attachments.

item.title: How to get Tifa and Barret's outfits in FFXIV
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's how to get Tifa and Barret's outfits in Final Fantasy 14, and how to participate in the Keybound Brawler event, the Final Fantasy 7 event.
item.content:encoded: Tifa and Barret's outfits are the real stars in Final Fantasy 14's event in the Keybound Brawlers, a new collaboration with Final Fantasy 7. Unlike Cloud's outfit, which is based on the Final Fantasy 7: Advent Children design and has been in the game for ages, these two are based on the FF7 remake project. To get them and many other FF7-themed cosmetics and items, you must survive the typing brawls and earn a special currency.

item.title: Discord's Massive New Change Will Shake Up The Entire Internet
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: [Filtered: Non-gaming industry news, not Polygon gaming focus] A shift in Discord's discoverability has massive implications for Google and Reddit and possibly ChatGPT and Claude
item.content:encoded: The best and worst thing about Discord is that messages sent on its chat servers are ephemeral. On the one hand, it's nice to know that things said in a casual setting won't necessarily be plastered on the internet forever. On the other hand, Discord's temporality is frustrating when you need to find a critical piece of information. These defining characteristics for Discord are about to change — and the repercussions will be visible throughout the entire internet.

item.title: Lord of the Rings’ New Aragorn Actor Officially Opens up on Role’s Immense Pressure

item.description: [Filtered: Film casting gossip without real substance] The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum's Aragorn actor Jamie Dornan admits it is hard to replace Viggo Mortensen.
item.content:encoded: It can't be easy taking over a role from an actor who so perfectly portrayed the character before. Yet that is exactly what Jamie Dornan (Fifty Shades of Grey, Once Upon a Time) is preparing to do. He will play Aragorn in The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum, replacing Viggo Mortensen. Dornan admitted he's feeling the pressure.

item.title: How to open the Nameless Ruins chest in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Final Fantasy Resonance's Namless Ruins chest houses an excellent set of armor, but you have to solve a riddle to get it
item.content:encoded: You're greeted with a sealed chest in Final Fantasy Resonance's Nameless Ruins, and it's hard to miss, since there's a big statue right next to it. When you approach the chest, however, you get a riddle with little guidance as to what it means — and the statue next to you is of no use. Yet. You'll need to make some progress in this dungeon and complete a few steps in the right order to open the chest, but the prize inside is worth the hassle.

item.title: 26 Years Later, BioWare’s Most Influential RPG Is Still Shaping My Life
item.dc:creator: Francesco Cacciatore
item.category: Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgic retrospective about old game, not a new announcement.] BioWare may be gone, but the studio's best RPG, Baldur's Gate 2, built a legacy that is still shaping lives today.
item.content:encoded: The game was Baldur’s Gate 2: Shadows of Amn. The T-shirt, which came with the collector’s edition, sported the game’s logo: two mirrored heads, one in light, one in darkness (the exact meaning of the image has been debated for the past 26 years, with no conclusive answer). I was the kid, of course. Soon after, I bought the game and, for the first time, immersed myself in the world of the Forgotten Realms, brought to life in digital form by BioWare. Almost three decades later, BioWare is gone. The sad news made me reflect on how Baldur’s Gate 2 and the other computer RPGs they developed between the 1990s and the early 2000s marked the trajectory of my life.

item.title: Legendary Sci-Fi Director's 129-Minute War-Action Masterpiece Is Being Cut From Netflix
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: streaming clickbait headline] Starship Troopers, directed by Paul Verhoeven, is a satirical military thriller that lampoons right-wing militarism.
item.content:encoded: When legendary director Paul Verhoeven's space action epic arrived in theaters 29 years ago, a lot of people didn’t get it. While the original 1959 novel by Robert A. Heinlein had a militaristic right-wing viewpoint, Verhoeven and screenwriter Edward Neumeier sought to lampoon those themes when they adapted it for the screen in 1997. Unfortunately, a number of critics mistook the movie’s satire for sincerity. The Washington Post, for example, called the movie “Nazi to the core.”

item.title: 5 Funniest 'Peanuts' Comics About Snoopy's Forgotten Siblings
item.dc:creator: Thomas Hindmarch
item.description: [Filtered: Graphic novel/comic excerpt and nostalgia retrospective filler.] Your Beagle Has a Rich Family Life, Charlie Brown
item.content:encoded: Charles Schulz's Snoopy is one of the most famous fictional dogs in the world, if not the most famous. His only real competition might be Goofy, who's apparently supposed to be an anthropomorphic dog (which, as ever, raises some real uncomfortable questions about Pluto), or possibly Scooby-Doo.

item.title: 29 Years Ago, ‘Buffy’s Wisest Character Got a Shocking Backstory that Redefined the Entire Series
item.dc:creator: Maria Loreto
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about old Buffy episode from 29 years ago.] Buffy the Vampire Slayer began to find its rhythm in season 2, after introducing an unnerving backstory to Rupert Giles.
item.content:encoded: In Buffy the Vampire Slayer, Halloween is the one night a year when monsters think it’s cliché to go out and torment the Hellmouth. As Buffy elegantly puts it: Halloween is “like, dead for the undead.” But 29 years ago, one evildoer decided to wreak havoc in Sunnydale on the one night no one expected. The result was an episode that explored the characters' deepest insecurities and gave the Scooby Gang an unexpected hero: Rupert Giles (Anthony Head), the fussy librarian who until then had served as Buffy’s moral compass and cheerleader. While he ended up saving the day, the episode added a wrinkle to his character, introducing his mysterious past as "Ripper."

item.title: The MCU's Oldest Villain Just Made a Surprise Return in 'VisionQuest'
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Marvel franchise casting/character gossip, big-franchise churn filler.] VisionQuest just brought back the character of Raza, the Ten Rings terrorist not seen since the first Iron Man movie
item.content:encoded: In the 2008 movie Iron Man, the biggest, baddest villain was Obadiah Stane, played by Jeff Bridges. Originally business partners with Tony Stark (Robert Downey Jr.), Obadiah betrayed Tony by hatching a plot to kill him while he was in Afghanistan. When Tony survived and became Iron Man, Obadiah responded by taking on his own iron identity: The Iron Monger.

item.title: 5 Adult Fairy Tale Books That Are Magical From Start to Finish
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: [Filtered: Book promotion and graphic novel content outside gaming focus.] Dive into fantastical worlds filled with wizards, fae, and dangerous quests
item.content:encoded: Fairy tales are often the first stories kids learn from picture books, and the works of Hanna Diyab, the Brothers Grimm, and Hans Christian Andersen can help inspire a lifelong passion for reading. But just because you grow up, doesn’t mean you have to abandon the genre. Modern fantasy books often strive for epic scale and complex political scheming, but it can be just as satisfying to explore a wondrous world where brave heroes fall in love and find the courage to do what’s right. If you want to bring some more magic to your reading list, check out these five fairy tale novels for adults.

item.title: How to unlock Lid's second limit burst in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Unlocking Lid's second limit burst in Final Fantasy Resonance works differently than the others. Here's how to get Lid's second limit burst
item.content:encoded: Getting Lid's second limit burst in Final Fantasy Resonance works a bit differently than the process of acquiring other characters' bursts. With most of the party, you just level them up, and they unlock once you hit the right milestone. You can guess when that is just from a quick scan of their skill list, as a new skill usually accompanies their new limit burst at the same level. But Lid's skill list is shorter, and since the game doesn't tell you how to unlock her second burst, you might wonder whether you've missed something.

item.title: Matthew Lillard Officially Teases Mystery Superman Man of Tomorrow Role
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: [Filtered: DC/Superman casting gossip; big-franchise churn toss pattern.] Man of Tomorrow actor Mathew Lillard reveals an unexpected hint about his secret role in the new DCU
item.content:encoded: Of all the new actors joining the cinematic DC Universe in next year's Man of Tomorrow, fans seem most invested in finding out which character Matthew Lillard will portray. Lillard (Carrie, Scream, Polygon's Shelf Quest) is set to appear in James Gunn's Supermansequel in an as-yet undisclosed role. There's already been one major fan theory that Gunn has shot down.

item.title: 8 MW4 DMZ beginner's tips to help you conquer Hajin
item.dc:creator: Ford James
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] A guide full of tips and tricks for players looking to succeed in Modern Warfare 4's DMZ mode.
item.content:encoded: If you want to stand the best chance of getting out alive, you need our DMZ tips for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. The series finally has a proper extraction mode and while it's not quite what was advertised ahead of launch, there's a lot of fun to be had by heading into Hajin, mowing down dozens of PvE enemies, and extracting with the best loot you can find.

item.title: Target Black Friday Leak Reveals Big Deals for Pokémon TCG Fans
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez

item.content:encoded: It may not be November yet, but retailers are already planning how they'll handle the year's biggest shopping event: Black Friday. Target has offered Black Friday deals on the Pokémon trading card game in previous years, and 2026 looks to be no different.

item.title: Pokémon Center Opens More Baffling 30th Anniversary TCG Orders
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: [Filtered: Pokémon TCG retail/restock news; trading card scalper adjacent.] Pokémon fans were looking forward to pre-orders for 30th Anniversary UPCs or Battle Decks, but TPC has other TCG plans
item.content:encoded: Pokémon's Eevee-themed 30th Anniversary Battle Deck is scheduled to drop on Oct. 30. A week after that is the release date for the highly-awaited Pokémon 30th Anniversary Ultra Premium Collection, the most expansive (and expensive) product in the celebratory lineup. Is The Pokémon Center doing pre-orders for either of these things this Tuesday? Of course not. The official pocket monster storefront is currently selling new trading card game items from the 30th Anniversary repertoire, yes, but its selection is as random as it is baffling.

item.title: 22 Years Ago, TV’s Best Sci-Fi Show Proved It Was About More Than the Mystery
item.dc:creator: Terry Terrones
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about old TV show from 22 years ago.] Lost's "House of the Rising Sun" captures the emotional revelations and tantalizing mysteries that made the series so addictive in 2004.
item.content:encoded: There was a time when Lost was more than just a television show. It was an obsession. Every episode introduced new mysteries, every character seemed to be hiding something, and every Wednesday night left viewers with more questions than answers. In the fall of 2004, nobody knew what was happening on the Island, and that was a huge part of the fun.

item.title: 10 Years Ago, Anime's Most Bonkers Series Introduced a Disturbing Villain Who Changed Everything
item.dc:creator: Debopriyaa Dutta
item.description: [Filtered: Anime nostalgia retrospective, not video game content.] This man has been single-handedly terrorizing Morioh for more than a decade.
item.content:encoded: Part 4 of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, called Diamond Is Unbreakable, also features an idyllic town with a rotten core. Author Hirohiko Araki changes things up after a globe-trotting adventure in Stardust Crusaders (Part 3), shifting the scene to the beautiful town of Morioh. Part 3 protagonist Jotaro Kujo seeks out Morioh resident Josuke Higashikata seeking to learn more about his true parentage, which triggers a string of bizarre events in this seemingly peaceful small town.

item.title: Adult Fairy Tales: The Best of the Best

item.title: Wildwood channels The Decemberists' folk fairytale legacy
item.dc:creator: Matt Patches
item.description: [Filtered: Animation film feature without game connection or real substance.] Colin Meloy and Carson Ellis talk about Laika's movie, the original book, sequels, and Portland.
item.content:encoded: “I feel like when we were first coming up with the story, we were trying to really go for the early stuff — pull from folktale and fair ytale tropes,” Meloy tells Polygon. “I think there’s so many things in the movie that, because that was really the intent from the outset, was to create a fairy tale. Inevitably, it ends up like fantasy in the context of 2026, but that’s what we were shooting for.”

item.title: 8 Most Entertaining Sci-Fi Books of the 21st Century That Are Impossible to Put Down
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: [Filtered: Graphic novel excerpts and book promos are not kept.] Get some laughs with psychic cats, friendly aliens, and snarky cyborgs
item.content:encoded: Science fiction writers imagine humanity's future in order to explore our present and past. The best sci-fi is a mix of cautionary tale and social commentary, but books about heady topics like artificial intelligence, alien encounters, and galaxy-spanning wars are often filled with dense explanations of theoretical technologies or complex political factions. It doesn't have to be that way. While dry and heavy sci-fi can be extremely rewarding to read, the genre also offers plenty of lighter options filled with humor and adventure. If you want some laughs in your future, check out these eight extremely fun sci-fi books that grapple with modern issues facing humanity in the 21st Century.

item.title: Major 'Avatar: Seven Havens’ Korra Reveal May Be Hiding the Truth About the Cataclysm
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: [Filtered: Generic animated series news; Avatar falls under big-franchise churn.] Did Korra destroy the world? An Avatar: Seven Havens flashback reveals her attacking Republic City, but the truth may be more complicated.
item.content:encoded: For more than two centuries, the world of Avatar: Seven Havens has remembered Korra as the Avatar who destroyed everything. Everybody from Ellora to New Ba Sing Se has grown up hearing that story, and episode 7 seemingly gives Pavi (Saheli Khan) and Nisha (Aishu Devan) them proof: They witness their predecessor in the Avatar State, tearing apart Republic City as spiritual energy whips through its burning streets.

item.title: 24 Years Later, Nintendo's Most Divisive Mario Game Is a Miracle on Switch 2
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective; old game suddenly popular again pattern.] Super Mario Sunshine was beloved at launch but grew to become one of the most divisive Mario games ever. Here's why it's worth playing in 2026.
item.content:encoded: I can’t remember what I had for lunch yesterday, but I still remember the daySuper Mario Sunshine launched in 2002. It was a summer's day and I couldn’t wait to line up at the GameStop in the Natick Mall to pick up my pre-ordered copy. It was getting rave reviews — a 9.4 from IGN, a 9.75 from Game Informer, perfect marks from Nintendo Power! — so it felt like an instant classic. Players at the time seemed to agree, considering that the 3D platformer would go on to become the third best-selling GameCube game of all time. Everyone loved Super Mario Sunshine.

item.description: [Filtered: Anime/animated series news outside game focus area.] Netflix released an official new KPop Demon Hunters choreography video for "How It's Done" aimed a KPDH fans.
item.content:encoded: While KPop Demon Hunters fans patiently wait for the forthcoming sequel, Netflix is dropping new video content from 2025's breakout animated musical adventure, starting with footage that didn't appear in the film. On Monday, Netflix released a short video that reveals the full choreography for Huntr/x's "How It's Done," promising that the new clip "is just the opening act" for new KPop Demon Hunters reveals.
